review_notes: Reviewed the whole file (two to_additive lemmas, no simp attributes, no local simp sets) and checked how Measure.mconv is declared in Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Group/Convolution.lean. Both results are iff/equation statements with side conditions (AEStronglyMeasurable, Integrable, SFinite) and a non-trivial normal form. Adding @[simp] to either would be unjustified: integral_mconv needs an integrability hypothesis, and integrable_mconv_iff has hypotheses and would expand a simple Integrable goal into a conjunction. The proof of integrable_mconv_iff uses `simp [Measure.mconv, ...]` locally. This unfolds a definition inside a proof only, so it doesn't affect the file's simp interface. I found no cycle, competing rule or unwanted expansion. I did not run Lean, so I can't rule out proof-level simp fragility, but I have no evidence of it.
